summary: Iteration 225 (frontend only): re-verified the three iteration-224 fixes on ENZI /lumi with admin@medmatch.com. ALL THREE FIXES PASS: (1) ENZI AI reply now renders LIVE in the open thread — after sending '@AI summarize this conversation' the ai-assistant-badge count went 4 -> 5 in ~3s with NO page reload; only ONE websocket was opened for the session (no zombie reconnects/churn observed). (2) AI markdown is now visible — computed styles on 60 .rich-message elements: strong = rgb(15,23,42), li = rgb(30,41,59), on background rgb(255,255,255) (contrast fine). (3) No cross-channel leak — posted a message via API to a different channel (ch_50330ae57e) while ch_5204a3057c was open; it did NOT appear in the thread and did not re-render into it after 5s. Regression: normal (non-@AI) message renders live in the open thread. NEW BUG FOUND (blocks the reaction regression check): the per-message hover action toolbar (react/thread/translate/edit/delete) renders UNDER the left sidebar and is unclickable.

ui_bugs.issue: The hover toolbar is absolutely positioned with `-top-7 right-0` inside a zero-width `relative inline-flex` wrapper placed at the LEFT edge of the message content, so it extends leftwards and its buttons land at viewport x≈165-285 — i.e. inside the fixed 280px-wide dark sidebar (`md:w-[280px]`). Measured: react-btn rect x=227 w=22; document.elementFromPoint at its centre returns the EnziSidebar channel <span>, and Playwright normal clicks are intercepted by the sidebar subtree (no horizontal document overflow: scrollWidth==clientWidth==1920, scrollLeft=0). Consequence: react / thread / translate / edit / delete are NOT clickable on desktop, and clicking there actually switches the active channel (the click hits the sidebar channel button underneath). Same problem for the emoji quick-picker (`-top-12 right-0`, measured x=181). Fix: anchor the toolbar to the right side of the message row (e.g. absolute right-4 top-0 on the row) or use `left-0`/`translate` so it never crosses x<300, and raise z-index above the sidebar.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify reaction add/remove through the UI because the react button/emoji picker are pointer-intercepted by the sidebar (see ui_bug). A forced click on the emoji produced 0 reaction chips ([data-testid^=reaction-] count = 0), so reaction persistence via UI remains UNVERIFIED — needs retest after the toolbar positioning fix (backend /messages/{id}/react was green in earlier iterations).

rca_of_the_issue: Reaction/hover-toolbar unclickable: MessageBubble renders the action toolbar as `absolute -top-7 right-0` inside a `relative inline-flex` wrapper that has zero width and sits at the left edge of the message content column (~x=285). With right-0 the ~120px-wide toolbar therefore extends leftwards to x≈165-285, overlapping the 280px fixed sidebar which has a later/higher stacking context, so document.elementFromPoint at the buttons returns sidebar nodes and clicks are swallowed (and switch channels). Not a test-script issue — reproduced with plain elementFromPoint measurement at scrollLeft=0.
